prompt:
Pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: glossy black obsidian ground with sharp purple-black facets and red reflections The square is about 256 x 256 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Camera: classic top-down RPG map view (seen from above at a steep angle, like a 16-bit era overworld/town map), orthographic, no perspective convergence.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
It must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. Fill the entire square edge to edge with the surface only: no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text, no single focal feature, even distribution of detail.
revised_prompt: Create a square, seamless tileable top-down JRPG terrain texture consisting ENTIRELY of glossy black obsidian ground. Premium modern hi-bit hand-crafted pixel art with strict uniform crisp square pixels and hard stair-stepped cluster edges, no antialiasing, blur, gradients, brush strokes, grain, noise or checkerboard dithering. Dark charcoal and purple-black irregular sharp angular facets, subtle restrained deep red reflections threaded across some facet boundaries; occasional tiny warm muted amber highlights, rich earthy hue-shifted ramps with 4–6 shades per material. Distributed fine and medium facet clusters of 3–10 art pixels, even visual density across whole image; no central feature. Orthographic straight overhead map view, soft neutral evenly distributed illumination from upper-left, clean base colors, no cast shadows, no light sources, no glowing, no vignette. CRITICAL: seamlessly repeatable in both horizontal and vertical directions: all shape and color patterns touching left edge match right edge, and top matches bottom, with no visible seam when tiled. Fill edge to edge with surface only; no border, objects, characters, text. Square texture.
